_comment: Copy this to hosts.json next to it and edit, or just fill in the
console's 연결 설정 tab and press 저장 - that writes this same file.
hosts.json is gitignored.
address: the Tailscale MagicDNS name, or the 100.x.y.z tailnet address.
Do NOT put a LAN address here. The point of going through Tailscale is
that the same name works from anywhere, and that nothing is exposed
outside the tailnet.
password: null means the console asks and keeps it in memory only, which
is what the 저장 button does - it never writes a password to this file.
Filling it in by hand works and survives a restart, but then it sits
here in plain text.
role: 'sender' or 'receiver' decides which probe runs and which panel is
drawn on the 개요 tab. Leave it out for a machine you only want a
terminal on.
host_key: SHA256 지문. 기기에서 직접 확인해 여기 적으십시오.
Windows:  ssh-keygen -lf C:\ProgramData\ssh\ssh_host_ed25519_key.pub
비워 두면 연결을 거부합니다. 첫 연결이 곧 자격 증명을 건네는 연결이라,
검증 없이 신뢰하면 응답한 무엇이든 비밀번호를 가져갑니다.
부트스트랩 중이라면 TSCONSOLE_TOFU=1 로 한 번 받아 지문을 확인하십시오.
key_file: 개인 키 경로. 비밀번호보다 낫습니다 — 재생 공격이 불가능하고,
회수가 기기의 authorized_keys 에서 한 줄 지우는 것으로 끝납니다.
누구에게도 요청할 필요 없이 우리가 직접 끊을 수 있습니다.
path: how the SSH connection is made.
'direct' 100.x:22 with a password. The default, and the only one
verified against these machines.
'tsssh'  Tailscale SSH - tailscaled authorises by tailnet identity and
no password is sent. Needs 'tailscale up --ssh' on the target.
'jump'   Reach the target through the SSH host in 'jump' below. This is
what 'relay' means in practice: a standard ProxyJump, so the
credentials never pass through anyone else's infrastructure.

hosts._example_only: A machine the tailnet cannot reach, via a jump host.
